newsHighlights.title: Xi congratulates Jinan University on its 120th founding anniversary
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory message to Jinan University on the 120th anniversary of its founding, praising its role in nurturing talent for the nation.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席向暨南大学建校120周年致贺信，称赞其为国家培养人才的重要作用。

newsHighlights.title: Xi urges breaking new ground in high-quality development of GBA
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping urged efforts to thoroughly study and implement the guiding principles of the fifth plenary session of the 20th CPC Central Committee and break new ground in the high-quality development of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席强调，要深入学习贯彻党的二十届五中全会精神，在粤港澳大湾区高质量发展上开创新局面。

newsHighlights.title: Decoding APEC in numbers
newsHighlights.summary: APEC member economies cover around 3 billion people, account for nearly half of global trade and about 60 percent of global economic output since its formal establishment in 1989.
newsHighlights.translation: 亚太经合组织成员经济体覆盖约30亿人口，占全球贸易近一半、全球经济产出约60%，自1989年正式成立以来不断壮大。

newsHighlights.title: When in Shanghai, they speak Shanghainese
newsHighlights.summary: Foreign residents in Shanghai are picking up the local dialect, showing how language learning builds bridges between cultures.
newsHighlights.translation: 在上海生活的外国居民正在学习本地方言，展现出语言学习如何在不同文化之间架起桥梁。

newsHighlights.title: Why does skyscraper-studded Shenzhen draw migratory birds year after year?
newsHighlights.summary: Shenzhen's improving wetland environment draws tens of thousands of migratory birds each winter, offering residents a living classroom of nature.
newsHighlights.translation: 深圳不断改善的湿地环境每年冬天吸引数万只候鸟，为市民提供了一座天然的生态课堂。

quote.quote: Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever.
quote.author: Mahatma Gandhi
quote.translation: 如同明天即将离世那样生活，如同永远活着那样学习。
quote.explanation: 这句话把「珍惜当下」与「终身学习」并列，提醒我们成长没有终点：既要有投入生活的热情，也要保持持续求知的耐心。它与今日暨南大学120周年校庆所传递的教育精神高度契合。

pattern.pattern: urge sb to do sth / urge efforts to do sth（敦促某人做某事 / 强调应努力做某事）
pattern.example: President Xi Jinping urged efforts to thoroughly study and implement the guiding principles of the fifth plenary session.
pattern.translation: 习近平主席强调，要深入学习贯彻党的二十届五中全会精神。
pattern.usage: urge 表示「强烈建议、敦促」，常见结构有：urge sb to do sth（敦促某人做……）、urge that + 主语 + (should) + 动词原形（正式书面语）、urge efforts to do sth（呼吁努力做……）。在新闻英语中常用于报道讲话、政策与倡议。例：The principal urged students to read widely beyond the classroom.（校长敦促学生在课堂之外广泛阅读。）

grammar.title: Since + 时间点，主句用现在完成时
grammar.explanation: 当句子以 since 引导一个过去的起点（时间点或一般过去时的从句）时，主句通常使用现在完成时（have/has + 过去分词），表示「从过去某时起一直持续到现在」的动作或状态。这一结构在新闻英语中高频出现，用于强调某事从某一历史节点延续至今的发展变化。
examples: Since its formal establishment in 1989, APEC has grown into a major platform for regional cooperation.
Since its founding 120 years ago, Jinan University has trained countless talents for the nation.

pronunciation.tips: 重音落在第三个音节 -ver- 上，读作 an-ni-VER-sa-ry。注意 /æ/（如 cat）开口较大，/v/ 要咬下唇；结尾的 -sary 读 /səri/，弱化为轻声，不要读成 /særi/。常见错误是把重音放在第一音节，听起来会不自然。
examples: Jinan University marked its 120th founding anniversary this week.
Our class held a special activity for the school's 50th anniversary.

reading.title: A University Turns 120: Education That Never Stops Growing
reading.content:
This week, Jinan University celebrated the 120th anniversary of its founding. Over more than a century, the university has trained generations of students who now work across China and around the world. Its story is a reminder that education is not a short race, but a lifelong journey.

That message fits a bigger picture. Since its formal establishment in 1989, APEC has grown into a platform that connects about 3 billion people, and its member economies account for nearly half of global trade. Growth on this scale depends on people who keep learning. In the Greater Bay Area, leaders are urging efforts to break new ground in high-quality development, which calls for better schools, stronger research and open minds.

Even a city can be a classroom. Every winter, tens of thousands of migratory birds visit Shenzhen's wetlands, teaching residents patience and respect for nature. Whether in a lecture hall or on a riverbank, learning continues — as long as we stay curious.
reading.translation:
本周，暨南大学迎来建校120周年。一百多年来，这所大学培养了一代又一代学生，他们如今活跃在中国乃至世界各地。它的故事提醒我们：教育不是一场短跑，而是一段终身的旅程。

这一理念与更大的图景相契合。自1989年正式成立以来，亚太经合组织已发展成为连接约30亿人口的平台，其成员经济体占全球贸易近一半。如此规模的发展，离不开持续学习的人。在粤港澳大湾区，领导人强调要努力在高质量发展上开创新局面，这需要更好的学校、更强的科研力量和更开放的思维。

甚至一座城市也能成为课堂。每年冬天，数万只候鸟到访深圳的湿地，教会居民耐心与对自然的尊重。无论是在讲堂还是在河岸，学习从未停止——只要我们保持好奇。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 CGTN《Xi congratulates Jinan University on its 120th founding anniversary》、ChinaDaily《Decoding APEC in numbers》《Xi urges breaking new ground in high-quality development of GBA》《Why does skyscraper-studded Shenzhen draw migratory birds year after year?》等今日新闻素材改写，用于英语学习。
